g.text: LeanAIR — the whole proof is one Poseidon chip trace
Rows are a public schedule. Columns are the Poseidon witness. Everything non-local is a linear claim over those same committed columns.
WHIR commits every column as one polynomial
every row is a valid width-16 compression,
Dense relations — the cell hash chain
global linear identities, not local transitions;
the schedule is public so both sides derive them
Parity check — the row low-degree test
reads the same limbs the Cell rows absorb,
so no second copy of the codeword exists
claim = AIR + η · cell_link + η² · sparse_linear
